name: Street Art Squalo
summary: A Fine Art custom Shitzu Squalo powerboat with a graffiti finish, sitting on a trailer in Key Lento.
body: Game8 describes it as a custom Shitzu Squalo with a graffiti-style finish and files it under the Fine Art vehicle type.
Game8 says it has a fixed spawn on a boat trailer at the north-east end of Sunset Dr in central Key Lento, and that a vehicle with a tow may be needed to push it into the water.
Game8 lists it as a 2000s powerboat with 2 seats, storage of 4 and no mod specialist.

facts.availability: Fixed spawn on a trailer, Sunset Dr, Key Lento
